Hi there 😊 Yes. A normal return follows the standard return policy: items must be unused, in the same condition you received them, with tags attached and in the original cloth shoe bags, and returns are within 30 days of delivery. Free exchanges and free returns for store credit are offered, while returns to the original payment method require you to cover the return shipping fee.

For a damaged item, it is handled as an order issue instead of a standard return. In that case, please send a photo of the damaged item, confirm which items arrived in good condition, and confirm your shipping address. Once that is provided, the issue can be reviewed and appropriate next steps can be determined. I cannot promise a reshipment in advance, but every effort will be made to resolve it 💛
